prova:
intro A hA
  obtain ⟨hcard, hdist_eq⟩ := hA
  have hmin : minimalDistinctDistances ℝ² 3 = 1 := by
    have h_opt := erdos_91.test.equiTriangle_optimal
    have hcard_eq : equiTriangle.card = 3 := h_opt.1
    have hdist_eq_min : distinctDistances equiTriangle = minimalDistinctDistances ℝ² 3 := h_opt.2
    have hdist_val : distinctDistances equiTriangle = 1 := by
      unfold distinctDistances distanceSet equiTriangle
      have eucl_dist_one_of_sq : ∀ {x y : ℝ²}, dist x y ^ 2 = 1 → dist x y = 1 := by
        intro x y h; nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y), sq_nonneg (dist x y)]
      have hd01 : dist (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0]) (!₂[(1 : ℝ), 0]) = 1 := eucl_dist_one_of_sq <| by
        rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two]; simp [Real.dist_eq]
      have hd02 : dist (!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0]) (!₂[(1 : ℝ) / 2, Real.sqrt 3 / 2]) = 1 :=
        eucl_dist_one_of_sq <| by
          rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
          simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 3,
            sq_abs ((0 : ℝ) - 1 / 2), sq_abs ((0 : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)]
      have hd12 : dist (!₂[(1 : ℝ), 0]) (!₂[(1 : ℝ) / 2, Real.sqrt 3 / 2]) = 1 :=
        eucl_dist_one_of_sq <| by
          rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
          simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (3 : ℝ) ≥ 0 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg 3,
            sq_abs ((1 : ℝ) - 1 / 2), sq_abs ((0 : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 3 / 2)]
      suffices h : ({!₂[(0 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ), 0], !₂[(1 : ℝ) / 2, Real.sqrt 3 / 2]} :
          Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image (fun (pair : ℝ² × ℝ²) => dist pair.1 pair.2) = {1} by
        simp only [h, Finset.card_singleton]
      refine Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_image.mpr
        ⟨⟨!₂[0, 0], !₂[1, 0]⟩, by simp [Finset.mem_offDiag], hd01⟩, fun d hd => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hd
      simp only [Finset.mem_offDiag, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hab
      obtain ⟨ha, hb, _⟩ := hab
      rcases ha with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> first
        | contradiction | exact hd01 | exact hd02 | exact hd12
        | (rw [dist_comm]; first | exact hd01 | exact hd02 | exact hd12)
    rw [← hdist_val, hdist_eq_min]
  have hdist_A : distinctDistances A = 1 := by rw [hdist_eq, hmin]
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, hab, hbc, hac, rfl⟩ : ∃ a b c : ℝ², a ≠ b ∧ b ≠ c ∧ a ≠ c ∧ A = {a, b, c} := by
    obtain ⟨a, s, ha, hs⟩ := Finset.card_eq_succ.mp hcard
    obtain ⟨b, t, hb, ht⟩ := Finset.card_eq_succ.mp hs
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp ht
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, not_or] at ha hb
    exact ⟨a, b, c, ha.1, hb, ha.2, rfl⟩
  have hd_pos : 0 < dist a b := dist_pos.mpr hab
  set d := dist a b
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hd_pos
  have hab_dist : dist a b = d := rfl
  have hbc_dist : dist b c = d := by
    have hmem1 : dist a b ∈ (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
      simp [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_offDiag, hab]
    have hmem2 : dist b c ∈ (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
      simp [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_offDiag, hbc]
    have hsingleton : (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) = {d} := by
      have hcard1 : (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2).card = 1 := hdist_A
      exact Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard1 ▸ by simp [hmem1]
    have h2 : dist b c ∈ ({d} : Finset ℝ) := hsingleton ▸ hmem2
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp h2
  have hac_dist : dist a c = d := by
    have hmem1 : dist a b ∈ (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
      simp [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_offDiag, hab]
    have hmem2 : dist a c ∈ (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) := by
      simp [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_offDiag, hac]
    have hsingleton : (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2) = {d} := by
      have hcard1 : (({a, b, c} : Finset ℝ²).offDiag.image fun p => dist p.1 p.2).card = 1 := hdist_A
      exact Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard1 ▸ by simp [hmem1]
    have h2 : dist a c ∈ ({d} : Finset ℝ) := hsingleton ▸ hmem2
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp h2

  let u1 : ℝ² := !₂[(b 0 - a 0) / (d ^ 2), (b 1 - a 1) / (d ^ 2)]
  let u2 : ℝ² := !₂[-u1 1, u1 0]
  let val_c := u2 0 * (c 0 - a 0) + u2 1 * (c 1 - a 1)
  let s : ℝ := if 0 ≤ val_c then 1 else -1

  have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = 1 := by
    dsimp [s]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num

  let f_fun (x : ℝ²) : ℝ² :=
    !₂[u1 0 * (x 0 - a 0) + u1 1 * (x 1 - a 1),
       s * (u2 0 * (x 0 - a 0) + u2 1 * (x 1 - a 1))]

  let v1 : ℝ² := b - a
  let v2 : ℝ² := !₂[-s * (b 1 - a 1), s * (b 0 - a 0)]
  let g_fun (y : ℝ²) : ℝ² :=
    !₂[a 0 + y 0 * v1 0 + y 1 * v2 0,
       a 1 + y 0 * v1 1 + y 1 * v2 1]

  have hab_sq : (b 0 - a 0)^2 + (b 1 - a 1)^2 = d^2 := by
    have h := EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq a b
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h
    linarith

  have h_u1_sq : (u1 0)^2 + (u1 1)^2 = 1 / d^2 := by
    dsimp [u1]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
    have h_div : ((b 0 - a 0) / d^2)^2 + ((b 1 - a 1) / d^2)^2 = ((b 0 - a 0)^2 + (b 1 - a 1)^2) / d^4 := by ring
    rw [h_div, hab_sq]
    field_simp

  have h_f_dist_sq : ∀ x y : ℝ², dist (f_fun x) (f_fun y) ^ 2 = (1 / d^2) * dist x y ^ 2 := by
    intro x y
    have hfx := EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq (f_fun x) (f_fun y)
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hfx
    have hxy := EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq x y
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at hxy
    dsimp [f_fun, u2] at hfx
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] at hfx
    have h_alg : (u1 0 * (x 0 - a 0) + u1 1 * (x 1 - a 1) - (u1 0 * (y 0 - a 0) + u1 1 * (y 1 - a 1)))^2 +
      (s * (-u1 1 * (x 0 - a 0) + u1 0 * (x 1 - a 1)) - s * (-u1 1 * (y 0 - a 0) + u1 0 * (y 1 - a 1)))^2 =
      ((u1 0)^2 + (u1 1)^2) * ((x 0 - y 0)^2 + (x 1 - y 1)^2) := by
      linear_combination
        ((x 0 - y 0)^2 + (x 1 - y 1)^2) * hs_sq * (u1 0)^2 +
        ((x 0 - y 0)^2 + (x 1 - y 1)^2) * hs_sq * (u1 1)^2 -
        ((x 0 - y 0)^2 + (x 1 - y 1)^2) * (u1 0)^2 -
        ((x 0 - y 0)^2 + (x 1 - y 1)^2) * (u1 1)^2
    rw [hfx, h_alg, h_u1_sq, hxy]

  have h_f_dist : ∀ x y : ℝ², dist (f_fun x) (f_fun y) = (1 / d) * dist x y := by
    intro x y
    have h_sq := h_f_dist_sq x y
    have h1 : 0 ≤ dist (f_fun x) (f_fun y) := dist_nonneg
    have h2 : 0 ≤ (1 / d) * dist x y := mul_nonneg (by positivity) dist_nonneg
    have h3 : ((1 / d) * dist x y)^2 = (1 / d^2) * dist x y ^ 2 := by ring
    rw [← h3] at h_sq
    nlinarith

  have h_left : ∀ x, g_fun (f_fun x) = x := by
    intro x
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [g_fun, f_fun, u1, u2, v1, v2] <;>
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] <;>
      linear_combination
        (x 0 - a 0) * hs_sq * (b 0 - a 0)^2 / d^2 +
        (x 0 - a 0) * hs_sq * (b 1 - a 1)^2 / d^2 +
        (x 1 - a 1) * hs_sq * (b 0 - a 0) * (b 1 - a 1) / d^2 -
        (x 1 - a 1) * hs_sq * (b 0 - a 0) * (b 1 - a 1) / d^2 -
        (x 0 - a 0) * hab_sq / d^2

  have h_right : ∀ y, f_fun (g_fun y) = y := by
    intro y
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [g_fun, f_fun, u1, u2, v1, v2] <;>
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one] <;>
      linear_combination
        y 0 * hab_sq / d^2 +
        y 1 * hs_sq * (b 0 - a 0) * (b 1 - a 1) / d^2 -
        y 1 * hs_sq * (b 0 - a 0) * (b 1 - a 1) / d^2 -
        y 0

  let r_nn : ℝ≥0 := ⟨1 / d, by positivity⟩
  have hr_ne : r_nn ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : (r_nn : ℝ) = 0 := congr_arg Subtype.val h
    dsimp [r_nn] at this
    linarith

  let dil_f : ℝ² ≃ᵈ ℝ² := {
    toFun := f_fun
    invFun := g_fun
    left_inv := h_left
    right_inv := h_right
    ratio := r_nn
    ratio_ne_zero := hr_ne
    edist_eq' := fun x y => by
      rw [edist_dist, edist_dist, h_f_dist x y]
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 / d := by positivity
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_mul h_nonneg
  }

  use dil_f

  have fa_eq : f_fun a = !₂[0, 0] := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> dsimp [f_fun] <;> simp

  have fb_eq : f_fun b = !₂[1, 0] := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i
    · dsimp [f_fun, u1]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      linear_combination hab_sq / d^2 - 1
    · dsimp [f_fun, u2, u1]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one]
      ring

  have fc_0 : f_fun c 0 = 1 / 2 := by
    have h1 : dist (f_fun c) (f_fun a) = 1 := by
      rw [h_f_dist c a, hac_dist]
      field_simp
    have h2 : dist (f_fun c) (f_fun b) = 1 := by
      rw [h_f_dist c b, dist_comm, hbc_dist]
      field_simp
    have h1_sq : dist (f_fun c) (!₂[0, 0]) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [fa_eq] at h1; linarith
    have h2_sq : dist (f_fun c) (!₂[1, 0]) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [fb_eq] at h2; linarith
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq] at h1_sq h2_sq
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1_sq h2_sq
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, sub_zero] at h1_sq h2_sq
    linarith

  have fc_1 : f_fun c 1 = Real.sqrt 3 / 2 := by
    have h1 : dist (f_fun c) (f_fun a) = 1 := by
      rw [h_f_dist c a, hac_dist]
      field_simp
    have h1_sq : dist (f_fun c) (!₂[0, 0]) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [fa_eq] at h1; linarith
    rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq] at h1_sq
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two] at h1_sq
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, sub_zero] at h1_sq
    have hfc1_sq : (f_fun c 1)^2 = 3 / 4 := by linarith [fc_0]
    have hfc1_pos : 0 ≤ f_fun c 1 := by
      dsimp [f_fun, s]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one]
      split_ifs with h_cond
      · exact mul_nonneg zero_le_one h_cond
      · have h_neg : val_c < 0 := not_le.mp h_cond
        linarith
    rw [← Real.sqrt_sq hfc1_pos, hfc1_sq]
    have h34 : (3 : ℝ) / 4 = 3 / 2^2 := by ring
    rw [h34, Real.sqrt_div (by positivity)]
    simp

  have fc_eq : f_fun c = !₂[1 / 2, Real.sqrt 3 / 2] := by
    ext i; fin_cases i
    · exact fc_0
    · exact fc_1

  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, equiTriangle]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · left; exact fa_eq
    · right; left; exact fb_eq
    · right; right; exact fc_eq
  · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨a, by simp, fa_eq⟩
    · exact ⟨b, by simp, fb_eq⟩
    · exact ⟨c, by simp, fc_eq⟩
